findings.body: The previous gap remains open. Without the story worktree, `where` can identify a task checkout or task ref containing an older plan and read notes. Both views can therefore report `plan_read: passed` even after the story branch's plan changes and requires another read. `_read` at board.py:540–543 reads only the supplied location; nextstep.py:378–384 already consults the story branch when its worktree is absent. Resolve both the plan and notes from the current story location before falling back to the landed copy. Add a command-level regression with the story worktree removed; the current plan test retains it.

findings.body: The previous gap remains open for both providers. With no matching `models.grill` entry, worker.py:245–251 supplies no Claude model flags, and codex.py:153–155 supplies no Codex model overrides. This Claude run consequently records null model and effort; codex.py:323–324 does likewise. Neither reader subsequently publishes its effective provider settings, leaving both machine views without the required metadata throughout these reads. Capture the effective selection and cover readers without Forge model configuration. The reader tests configure model and effort explicitly; the default-selection cases cover reviewers only.
